svg.title: Ila starts the ceremony while workers still push the empty inspection vehicle.
svg.desc: Vale calmly records a variance while Riju, Cecil and Babul-da continue towards the ceremony on foot. In the same view, Ila is already speaking at the distant lectern as municipal workers manually push the empty official vehicle around the obstruction.
svg.text: Page 2, panel 5 · Wide lateral shot of the improvised arrival tableau

text.tspan: The people and robot proceed on foot while Ila
starts the ceremony and the empty official vehicle
is still being pushed to its marker.
